blocks.title: Photocraft in the activity panel
blocks.description: Layers, masks, type and real PSD files — the upstream Photocraft editor running inside Astravia, on your own machine, with the file you opened in the workspace.

showcase.assistant_reply: Photocraft is open. Select the file in the Explorer, then press Open — it takes that file.

items.title: The real editor, unmodified
items.description: The panel serves the official Photocraft web build byte for byte. Upstream's wasm and JavaScript are not patched; only two thin files of ours are added around them.

items.title: Open and save inside your project
items.description: Opening uses the file you selected in the Explorer, and saving writes back through Astravia — so the bytes land in your workspace instead of a downloads folder.

items.title: Speak to it in the conversation
items.description: Ask for the current view, hand the editor a file, or open the same page in a browser — five tools the Agent calls, each one answered by the running page.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: Add it from the marketplace. The editor's own files are about 13 MB, fetched once on first open into the plugin's data directory, and reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the Photocraft tab
items.description: The first open shows a preparation screen while the editor arrives; after that it starts from cache without touching the network.

items.title: Select an image in the Explorer, then open it
items.description: Inside the editor, File → Open takes the file you selected instead of showing a dialog.

items.title: Save back with File → Save
items.description: The working copy is written to the same path. Export… asks where to save instead.

blocks.content: In the browser entry points there is no workspace binding: opening a file there uses the browser's own picker and saving downloads through the browser. Working on project files happens in the Astravia tab.
Photocraft has no way to tell the panel whether a document has unsaved edits, so reloading the tab asks nothing. The editor's own title bar is the only unsaved marker.
